positions.title: Staff Software Engineer(L6-2)
positions.description:
• Modernized Identity Infrastructure: Led the end-to-end migration of 25 tenants from Keycloak v15 to v26. Eliminated manual configuration by implementing a self-serve Terraform workflow, achieving 100% automation for client updates.
• Strengthened Account Security: Scaled SMS-based MFA adoption from 10% to a majority of the global seller base, successfully neutralizing email-based 2FA as a primary account takeover (ATO) vector.
• Strategic Roadmapping: Established the company’s first structured ATO trend reporting for executive leadership. Successfully advocated for "Zero ATO" initiatives, securing the inclusion of Passkey adoption on the active platform roadmap.
• Cross-Functional Leadership: Orchestrated cross-org alignment without a formal mandate to unify infrastructure, product, and engineering teams behind secure-by-default platform capabilities and scalable IAM architecture.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead Enterprise Integration team responsible for building integrations for various
data flows between SaaS-based applications and in-house engineering applications.
• Facilitated seamless end-to-end data flows and provided architectural guidance as a
liaison between cross-functional teams, including vendors.
• Conducted thorough gap assessments to identify process and best practices gaps,
collaborating with management to effectively resolve them.
• Played a crucial role in technology governance by establishing integration
technology standards, frameworks, and roadmaps alongside Enterprise and
Solutions Architects.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead Auth Platform team(responsible for authenticating and authorizing Twitter user requests and third party client applications)
• Worked with senior leadership to develop a long-term authentication and authorization strategy for various entities at Twitter
• Developed and effectively managed extremely large-scale tier-0 distributed systems with tight latency restrictions and high availability needs.
• Collaborated with numerous product teams to aid in the introduction of numerous new product features
•  Mentored and up-levelled multiple engineers from L2 to Sr, Sr to Staff

positions.title: Software Engineer 3
positions.description:
• Worked on Adobe Cloud Platform's Content Services team, developing a central content repository API used by Adobe applications and third-party developers.
• Built and maintained distributed services on Azure and AWS, focusing on enterprise storage features like provisioning, access management, version control, and smart tagging.
• Contributed to Adobe Experience Manager – Mobile Product, enhancing customer portal capabilities and developing scalable backend services.
• Utilized technologies such as Java, JAX-RS, Spring, DynamoDB, RDS, Cassandra, EC2, Jenkins, AngularJS, and HTML5.

positions.description:

• Worked on developing highly scalable, service-oriented architectures to enable nearly real-time analysis and management of a worldwide fulfillment platform.

positions.title: Assistant System Engineer
positions.description:
• Served as an offshore team member in TCS's TCoE for Pfizer Inc., USA, performing various types of performance testing (Load, Stress, Volume) on applications in both shared and dedicated environments.

projects.title: Neural Network And Web Intelligence
projects.description:
Created a 1-3-1 multilayer neural network and trained it to learn continuous functions using
back propagation.Implemented kolmogorov equations for the learning purpose. Also ,implemented Perceptron to learn discrete functions like - nand operator.

projects.title: Four Square Checkin Analysis
projects.description:
•	Created Hadoop Cluster of 5 nodes (1 Master and 4 Chile nodes)
•	Installed Hadoop using Cloudera distribution of Hadoop
•	Analyzed 25 GB of Check In data. Created Query using HiveQL
